title: NEON VEIL — Run the Last Light
description: Rin Voss races through a rain-drenched megacity, hunted by a corporate sentinel. She ignites a photon blade and cuts a path through the neon night.

style.visual_identity: Original premium cyberpunk action anime in 2.5D, with expressive cel-shaded cutout characters, hand-inked outlines, deep parallax city plates and graphic neon lighting.
style.lighting: Rainy night, cyan rim lights from the street, magenta security scan, warm moon haze, emissive signage, bloom and reflective roadway accents.
style.linework: Bold dark anime contours, carefully layered cel shadows, thin specular accents, graphic silhouette separation and restrained bloom.
style.camera: Horizontal widescreen cinematic framing with wide establishing view, tracking move, aggressive push-in, controlled impact shake and final hero hold.
style.motion: Anticipation, overlapping scarf and hair, two-segment limb articulation, readable sprint cycles, skid recoil, blade ignition, airborne attack and follow-through.

characters.name: Rin Voss
characters.design_notes: Original young adult street courier with swept dark blue-black hair, vivid cyan streak, expressive amber-shadowed eyes, graphite armored jacket with teal and magenta accents, segmented boots and a long magenta scarf. Entire costume and face are original.

characters.name: Sentinel-09
characters.design_notes: Original hovering corporate hunter drone with a dark metallic chassis, magenta optic, rotating twin scan rings, swept stabilizer fins and a cone-shaped scan emitter.

shots.action: Rin sprints into a towering rain-soaked avenue; the camera tracks beside her as traffic slices through the distant skyline.
shots.camera: wide low tracking shot with strong layered parallax

shots.action: Sentinel-09 drops from the overpass, its twin rings spin up and a magenta search beam sweeps the street.
shots.camera: tilt-up and compress into a threatening over-shoulder angle

shots.action: Rin plants her boot, skids across wet pavement and reaches behind her shoulder for the photon blade.
shots.camera: medium three-quarter push-in with a short impact shake

shots.action: The cyan blade ignites, throwing bright reflections across her face, jacket and the rain.
shots.camera: tight hero push-in with a slight orbit

shots.action: Rin launches upward through the scan beam, scarf and jacket trailing as she swings the blade in a rising arc.
shots.camera: fast lateral dolly and upward follow

shots.action: A crescent slash cuts across frame; the drone staggers in a burst of sparks and Rin lands in a strong final pose.
shots.camera: impact shake into a composed wide hero hold
